Desktop

The User selects Create/Edit Character from the left side navigation. A Tab section appears on screen. The user begins by selecting if this is a new character to the database. If not they search for the character by name. Once the character is found their info is populated through out the tab sections for review and edit. After a change is made it must be saved. If character is searched again before selecting save no data will be pushed to database. User is unable to select other tabs of the Create/Edit section. Nor are they able to select Stat to move to the next tab if the required fields are not enter in. If this is a new character it has to be saved before the user can continue on. If this is to edit a character you have to have the characters name and select search and required fields populated before continuing.

Can distribute 69 points among 7 attributes, These attributes affect everything one way or another.  As you increase and decrease the attributes this will effect overall heath, stamina, and magic vitals. All attributes need at least 1 point in them. Starting at leve 5 and every 5th level after that character can have one of three options happen. They can have an attribute raise by 2 points, two attributes raised by 1 point, or choose to have a feat that gives unique abilities or buffs.

What this app is

The Forge app is intended to be a UI function to help with the construction and facilitate the flow of making characters, skills, abilities, spells, items, and much more. There is a lot of data flowing in a game. From a D&D game to a interactive story or even a video game. The Forge is here to hammer out the organization of your games components
